## Weekly Training Digest
Runs every Sunday at 6:30 PM.
Queries Supabase directly via Postgres node, builds a digest, sends to ntfy/coaching.

Credentials needed: "n8n_readonly" (Postgres) and "ntfy" (HTTP Header Auth).

parameters.query: SELECT date, hrv, sleep_score, sleep_seconds, acute_training_load, chronic_training_load, training_status, weight_kg, body_fat_pct, body_battery, training_readiness FROM garmin_daily WHERE date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY date DESC

SELECT name, activity_date, distance_m, moving_time_s, average_watts, weighted_average_watts, max_watts, average_heartrate FROM strava_activities WHERE sport_type = 'Ride' AND activity_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY activity_date DESC
SELECT title, start_time FROM hevy_workouts WHERE start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY start_time DESC
